{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Replace sentinel values with NaN for analysis
trial_df_clean = trial_df.copy()
trial_df_clean['biomarker_baseline'] = trial_df_clean['biomarker_baseline'].replace(-999.0, pd.NA)

# Check if the missing biomarker_baseline is associated with sex
print("Association between missing biomarker_baseline and sex:")
print(pd.crosstab(trial_df_clean['biomarker_baseline'].isna(), trial_df_clean['sex']))

# Check if the missing biomarker_baseline is associated with arm
print("\nAssociation between missing biomarker_baseline and arm:")
print(pd.crosstab(trial_df_clean['biomarker_baseline'].isna(), trial_df_clean['arm']))

# Check if the missing biomarker_baseline is associated with severity
print("\nAssociation between missing biomarker_baseline and severity:")
print(pd.crosstab(trial_df_clean['biomarker_baseline'].isna(), trial_df_clean['severity']))"}
